We need the target SMILES. The target is likely the product of the reduction of nitro to amine? Wait template_search-2 described reduction of nitro groups to amines. The mapped_rxn shows a transformation from nitro aromatic to amine aromatic. The target molecule (product) is the amine version. The mapped_rxn shows product on right side after >>. The product SMILES is after >>: "[CH3:1][C:2]([CH3:3])([CH3:4])[O:5][C:6](=[O:7])[N:8]1[CH2:9][CH2:10][N:11]([c:12]2[cH:13][c:14]([NH2:15])[cH:16][c:17]3[c:18]2[O:19][C:20]2([CH2:21][CH2:22][CH2:23]2)[CH2:24][CH2:25]3)[CH2:26][CH2:27]1"

That's the product SMILES. So target molecule is that SMILES. We need to apply template 2895 to that SMILES to get precursors. Use apply_template tool.

Let's call apply_template with molecule_smiles = that product SMILES, template_id = "2895".
